model.rapid_shift_proxy: Available time = min(attack spacing, released-fretting gap + min(125ms, attack spacing)). Open notes/rests count; time holding a fretted chord does not count as free travel. Risk sums round(1000 * max(0, distance - 8*time)^2 / max(time, 0.0625)). This estimates transition difficulty, not measured hand speed or guaranteed comfort.
model.picking_proxy: Choose ascending/descending chord sweeps; minimize string travel and skipped-string effort. No alternate/economy picking convention is imposed or inferred.
model.shape_scope: Explicit drop-power and adjacent-string power shapes, CAGED major/common minor chord templates, and E/A minor-pentatonic fragments. Complete 2/3-NPS and arpeggio phrase recognition is not claimed.
model.search: Exact dynamic programming within the finite model. Priority tiers are compared lexicographically.
model.baseline: Physically admitted per-attack open-first, lowest-fret greedy mapping with nearest reachable anchor.

objective.chord_skip_definition: Sum of unstruck strings between adjacent sorted strings in an exact co-attack. Held-only notes are not new attacks.
objective.rapid_skip_definition: For consecutive attack groups that each contain exactly one new note, with onset gap at most rapid_max_gap_seconds, add max(0, abs(string difference) - 1). Same and adjacent strings both cost zero. Chords and longer gaps break the run; other ringing notes do not.
objective.repeated_shape_definition: For successive fretted attacks within 0.75 seconds, if at least two pitches recur, count recurring pitches moved to a different string/fret. Open-only attacks preserve the previous shape memory.
objective.direction_definition: Count nonzero string-direction changes within a rapid single-attack run. Repeated-string attacks retain the last nonzero direction; chords and long gaps reset it. Chord orders are canonical bass-to-treble annotations.
objective.deterministic_tie_break: Lexicographic occurrence-ordered string/fret and anchor path, after all three primary and all four secondary costs are equal.
